defects.title: Legacy assignment is not atomic
reproduction: Two workers can read the same unassigned order before separate writes complete.
defects.root_cause: Batch, stops and order claim are separate PostgREST requests.
defects.recommended_next_action: Validate and activate one atomic writer in isolated staging before any rollout.

defects.title: Multiple dispatch writers and state models coexist
defects.root_cause: Legacy, Frank DB, Frank JS and optional atomic paths evolved independently.
defects.recommended_next_action: Inventory runtime writers and enforce tenant-scoped single-writer election.

defects.title: Pick completeness is not a server invariant
reproduction: Mark an item missing; it counts as confirmed and enables completion after all rows are marked.
defects.root_cause: Completeness and missing-item policy live in the client and separate database RPC.
defects.business_impact: Driver may depart with missing or incompletely picked assigned orders.
defects.recommended_next_action: Define an atomic batch-pick server transition with explicit missing-item resolution.

defects.title: Critical legacy lifecycle writes are client-side
defects.root_cause: Browser Supabase client is used as business service.
defects.business_impact: Server state transitions can be bypassed or partially applied.
defects.recommended_next_action: Move critical mutations behind authenticated versioned APIs and least-privilege RLS.

defects.title: No reproducible full E2E and concurrency release gate
evidence: available tests are pure TS and SQL contracts
defects.root_cause: No proven isolated staging stack and device test pipeline.
defects.recommended_next_action: Create isolated schema-compatible staging and mandatory race/device E2E gates.

defects.title: Legacy dispatcher allows missing GPS
reproduction: A driver with null coordinates remains in nearby candidates.
defects.root_cause: Legacy fallback prioritizes availability over location validity.
defects.recommended_next_action: Fail closed or explicit supervised fallback after atomic baseline is active.

defects.title: Background GPS is not implemented natively
defects.root_cause: Background entitlement exists without CLLocationManager/background service code.
defects.business_impact: Stale driver location when minimized, locked or killed.
defects.recommended_next_action: Implement and device-test a policy-compliant native tracker after privacy decision.

defects.title: GPS writes have no ordering or error handling
reproduction: Send delayed requests in reverse order; server timestamp reflects arrival and last write wins.
defects.root_cause: No device timestamp, sequence or compare-and-swap; database errors ignored.
defects.business_impact: Older points may replace newer position and history may silently fail.
defects.recommended_next_action: Version GPS events and enforce monotonic current-position updates.

defects.title: Two incompatible offline queues use one storage key
reproduction: Enqueue using one representation and mount the other queue reader.
defects.business_impact: Lost, malformed or duplicated offline actions.
defects.recommended_next_action: Replace with one versioned outbox and server idempotency contract.

defects.title: Long-distance hold is not persisted and ignores kitchen load
defects.root_cause: Pure policy was connected only as log-and-return.
defects.business_impact: Operational hold state is not visible or coordinated with kitchen.
defects.recommended_next_action: Do not activate until canonical persistent deadline and kitchen/route feasibility exist.
